note: Dubuque County Conservation park on the North Fork Maquoketa River ~5 mi N of Dyersville: wooded, with more than two miles of nature trail (a winter bald eagle roost), ball fields, volleyball, playground and rentable pavilions; resident park attendant year-round. Public hunting in season. --Claude
summary: Electric 30 -> 50; max rig 30 -> 75 (site pages 36-75 ft; pull-throughs added); showers confirmed, flush toilets/dump/water added; season note added; booking filled (mycountyparks, 1 year, 4 days ahead, 14 nights; 75% reservable confirmed); $30 confirmed. Waterfront lead: riverfront -> creekside (~15 m stream).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD riverfront -> creekside: at the campground the North Fork Maquoketa is ~15-17 m of open water (measured on 110 m frames), under the ~30 m river line, so it reads as a creek. On-water itself holds: mowed open grass runs from the pads to the sandy bank with no road or driveway between. Candidates ~5-8: the 3-4 pads on the south row along the entry road (an RV at ~42.5312,-91.1281 sits ~30 m from the bank) and the east side of the north loop (~40-50 m of open grass to the bank). Pin 42.53249,-91.12768 is on the north loop; fine.
MAX RIG 30 -> 75: the stored 30 ft came from the old note; every county site page gives 36-75 ft, so it is replaced.
SITE COUNT: 24 sites are listed online and the county calls that 75%, which implies ~32; no count is stated, left absent.
